== Rules == 
* '''Cup:''' Clans will be seeded and placed in a playoff tree. All games are BO5. 

* '''Match procedure:''' First map pick decided by cmd rnd. If 1-1, first picker pick again. If 2-0, losing clan picks 3rd. If 2-1, losing clan picks 4th. If 2-2, play last map. No map can be played twice.

* '''Maps:''' DM2, DM3, E1M2, SCHLOSS, PHANTOMA 

* '''Server settings:''' Standard settings set by command /4on4

* '''Reporting:''' Report the game with screenshots in #eql-cup

* '''Clans and players:''' State your lineup when signing up. It is ok for a player to play in more than one clan as long as the clans are not in the same division.
